**Verdict: see note.**

**Vacuous on a single quatrain.** Four unrelated lines satisfy it, because the interlock is a relation *between* stanzas and one stanza has none. Two stanzas discriminate correctly. A pantoum is by definition interlocking, so a caller checking four lines is told something the form does not support.
